contacts.label: Contacts
contacts.description: Map of person names to the sound played when a notification mentions them. Key: the exact name. Value: absolute path to a .ogg or .mp3 file.

match_case_sensitive.label: Case sensitive matching
match_case_sensitive.description: When off, the name is searched ignoring capitalization.

only_apps.label: Only these apps
only_apps.description: Optional list of notification app names to restrict matching to. Leave empty to match notifications from any app.

glyph.label: Icon
glyph.description: Icon shown in the bar for this widget.

show_widget.label: Show bar icon
show_widget.description: When off, the bell icon is hidden from the bar.
